sentences.text: Researchers introduced MapMyCells, a software tool designed to map single-cell data to brain cell classification systems with minimal data preparation.

The framework was tested against six different existing brain cell maps covering mice, humans, Alzheimer's patients, and other groups, successfully identifying cell types using gene expression, epigenetics, and spatial information.

Testing showed the tool achieves accuracy similar to other methods while requiring less computing power, allowing large datasets to be processed on ordinary computers. The authors state this offers a flexible and scalable solution for building unified maps of brain cells.
